label: Reusable names and entities graph
failure_mode: Keep ordinary lexical lookup available and omit unsupported name/entity enrichment.
invariants: Generic reusable name data cannot by itself prove that a passage refers to a specific story entity.
Localized, translated, transliterated, traditional and source-attested name forms remain explicitly typed.
Exact story-character identity requires occurrence evidence from the occurrence graph.
Name relationships remain reviewed claims rather than inferred equivalence from spelling similarity.
